using_mode_note: Public Pythonic nested USING, dotted selectors and namespace choices follow ../pythonic-using.md; older nesting, field-selector and constant/call-name rejections below remain for the future strict milestone.
scope: Chosen checked FOR calls, read-only counter references and deterministic cleanup; no new native counter-state claim

implementation_choices.calls: Global counters in the program or parameter-free routines may call helpers when transitive potential global writes exclude active global counters; fresh local counters have separate storage
implementation_choices.proof: Flow-insensitive fixed point over recursive calls; assignments, FOR initialization and built-in outputs count; writable formals map actual roots to caller global/formal writes; local shadowing is separate; dead branches remain potential writes
implementation_choices.references: Bare active counters may bind only to transitively read-only formals; grouped/expression actuals and INTEGER-to-REAL promotion are independent values
implementation_choices.bounds: Evaluate and store initial once, evaluate final once, capture resulting counter/start and inclusive stop; final-bound effects may change current start but cannot write active outer counters
implementation_choices.cleanup: After successful initial assignment, finally clear each initialized counter on normal/empty completion, RETURN, ABORT, final-bound errors, body errors, callback failure/interruption or resource-limit failures
implementation_choices.initial_failure: Do not clear a counter whose initial expression or checked initial assignment fails; retain earlier storage/effects
implementation_choices.return: Evaluate and validate the result before finally cleanup and frame exit; returned aggregate copies remain independent
implementation_choices.failure: Clear initialized active counters while retaining all other prior effects and nested output; ABORT remains sticky; no callback retry or rollback
implementation_choices.report: routine_effects potential_global_writes and potential_parameter_writes expose the proof; for_policy describes current limits and cleanup

retained_boundaries: INTEGER counters; no direct body writes or nested counter reuse
No formal counters or nonlocal counters in parameterized routines; use fresh local variables
No potentially writable active-counter reference actuals or helper global-counter writes
No labels/jumps inside FOR bodies; existing type, initialization, storage, output and resource-limit checks
Conservative tests remain internal for the future strict milestone; host callbacks are external effects, without native scheduling/runtime equivalence
